'''Peder''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] from [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. He was friends with [[Unidentified Tethan youngling|another youngling from Teth]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Peder was present at the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]].
